raw_segments.text: I, and all splintered to pieces, stub.
But even with a broken bone, old Ahab is untouched, and I account no living bone of mine one jot
more me than this dead one that's lost.
Nor white whale, nor man, nor fiend, can so much as graze old Ahab in his own proper and
Can any lead touch yonder floor, any mast scrape yonder roof, aloft there?
